CHAPTER.VERS: And Jehovah said to me, Go again, love a woman loved by a companion, yet an adulteress, like the love of Jehovah toward the sons of Israel, who turn to other gods and love raisin cakes of grapes.
So I bought her for myself with fifteen pieces of silver, and with a homer and a half of barley.
And I said to her, You shall stay with me many days. You shall not be a harlot, nor be with another man, and I also will be for you.
For the sons of Israel shall remain many days without king or ruler, and without sacrifice, and without pillars, and without ephod or teraphim.
Afterward the sons of Israel shall return and seek Jehovah their God and David their king. And they shall fear Jehovah and His goodness in the latter days.
